selection_basis: Integration acceptance of the existing public MA5 entry; preselected for traceability, not performance. Prior A research exposure is known.
label: close[t+h]/close[t]-1; signal after close[t]; price diagnostic only, no execution claims
preprocessing: none; complete pairs; no fill, clipping, winsorization or cross-sectional rank
incremental_baseline: OLS intercept + trailing 1-bar return; augmented with one factor; fit/scaling only in early sample with purged label boundary; late sample MSE comparison descriptive only

excluded.volume_features: Native base/quote unit not certified for the selected dataset; not needed
excluded.RSI: No reviewed selected source mapping; Wilder/EMA/SMA smoothing not interchangeable
excluded.cross_sectional: Only one accepted asset; no simultaneous PIT universe or industry neutralization
